persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, magenta-and-turquoise jumpsuit, short natural hair, empty-handed
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left in her doorway, hands on her hips

persos.desc: landlady in her 50s, turquoise-and-violet boubou, big gold necklace, holding ONE single smartphone
persos.pose: standing on the right in the corridor, slightly behind, holding the phone screen toward the tenant

dialogue: Tantie, pourquoi mon loyer-là augmente encore ?!
Ton statut-là montre restaurant. Donc tu as l'argent dêh.
C'était au mariage de mon ami, Tantie !
Ton ami-là habite où ? Lui aussi je vais l'augmenter.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The tenant, three-quarters to the camera, hands on her hips, protests. The landlady turns the phone screen toward her, triumphant. The tenant throws her hands up. The landlady narrows her eyes, very interested, and says her last line, her face clearly visible.
chute: The tenant freezes, mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the young tenant's horrified face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA PROPRIÉTAIRE EN LISANT TES STATUTS :
mecanisme: logique absurde de la propriétaire poussée jusqu'à vouloir augmenter un inconnu
